blockingFindings.description: Direct review of the current front, back, left, right, three-quarter, neutral, arms-up, arm-cross, crouch, sit, and prone renders shows a dense, sharply faceted overskirt with an uneven, ballooned pleat silhouette in neutral views. In crouch and sit, angular panels lift and jut around the thighs while the center-front layer falls behind the legs; coverage remains visibly poor. The V175 hem-edge pin is measured only in neutral and does not make the posed result acceptable.

Gray, body-colored-looking patches and hard surface facets remain visible on the ivory chest and waist in the front and posed views. Their cause is not established by these images; appearance is visibly defective and requires resolving the surface construction or shading before acceptance.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
